app.name: Smart Analysis Road
app.demoDataHint: Synthetic records are shown. They are labelled and can be hidden.
app.offline: Can't reach the server. Check your connection, then try again.
app.serverError: Something went wrong on our side. Try again in a moment.
app.aiUnavailable: The AI isn't available right now. Try again in a moment.
app.dailyLimit: You've reached today's limit of {{limit}}. It resets at midnight.
app.rateLimited: Too many requests. Wait a moment, then try again.

auth.panelBody: See which road to fix first, and which agency is responsible for it.
auth.registerBody: Report road hazards and follow what happens to them.
auth.privacy: We keep only your email address. Your reports never show who sent them.
auth.verifyBody: Enter the 6-digit code we sent to {{email}}.
auth.forgotBody: We'll email you a code to set a new password.
auth.newPasswordBody: Enter the code we sent to {{email}}, then choose a new password.
auth.notConnectedBody: This copy of the app has no Clerk key, so accounts are switched off. In development, the API acts as the role set in DEV_AUTH_ROLE.

errors.noAccount: No account uses this email. Check the spelling, or create an account.
errors.wrongPassword: That password doesn't match. Try again, or reset it.
errors.emailTaken: An account already uses this email. Sign in instead.
errors.pwned: This password has appeared in a data breach. Choose a different one.
errors.weak: Choose a longer or less common password.
errors.invalidEmail: Enter an email address like name@example.com.
errors.wrongCode: That code doesn't match. Check the latest email and try again.
errors.codeExpired: That code has expired. Send a new code.
errors.googleOnly: This account signs in with Google, so it has no password to reset. Use Continue with Google on the sign-in page.
errors.tooMany: Too many attempts. Wait a few minutes, then try again.
errors.locked: This account is locked after too many attempts. Try again later.
errors.extraStep: This account needs a step this app doesn't support yet. Contact a JKR admin.
errors.generic: Something went wrong with sign-in. Try again.

access.deniedTitle: You don't have access to this page
access.deniedOfficer: Your account doesn't have officer access. Ask a JKR admin to grant it.
access.deniedAdmin: This page is for admins. Ask a JKR admin if you need it.
access.forbidden: Your account doesn't have access to this. Ask a JKR admin if you need it.
access.outOfScope: This is outside the state or district your account covers.
access.signInAgain: Your session has ended. Sign in again to continue.
access.notConfiguredBody: This build has no Clerk key, so protected pages are closed. Set VITE_CLERK_PUBLISHABLE_KEY and rebuild.

outline.overdue: Red dot: past its repair deadline

map.roadHint: Zoom in and select any road to see who maintains it.
map.risk: Thicker, darker lines mean higher risk.
map.noneShown: Choose at least one hazard to show.
map.demoModel: These predictions come from a model trained mostly on demo data. Treat them as a demonstration.
map.truncated: Too many items to show at once. Zoom in to see them all.
map.noRoadHere: No mapped road within 50 m of that spot.

drawer.label: Details
drawer.noActions: This incident is closed. No further steps.
drawer.undoExpired: Too late to undo. Change the status again instead.
drawer.viewOnly: Your account can view incidents but not change them.
drawer.notVerified: Not yet confirmed: maintenance contracts change in 2026.
drawer.ruleBased: Ownership worked out from the road type, not a route number. An officer can correct it.

priority.title: Prioritized roads
priority.intro: Ranked by priority score. Each bar shows what the score is made of.
priority.miniMap: Map of the roads in this list
priority.miniMapHint: The {{count}} roads in this list. Hover a road or a row to match them.

admin.title: Admin
admin.usersBody: Everyone who registers starts as a public reporter. Give staff the role and state they work in.
admin.needsState: Officers and viewers need a state.
admin.sourcesBody: Scheduled jobs and today's use of each free service. Everything stays within free limits.
admin.noModels: No models yet. The nightly job trains them.
admin.agenciesBody: Contracts are in transition in 2026. Confirm each one before relying on it.

errorPage.notFoundBody: The link may be old or mistyped. Start again from your start page.
errorPage.crashBody: Reload to try again. If it keeps happening, tell the team what you were doing.

landing.tagline: Road hazards and repair priorities for Peninsular Malaysia
landing.title: Every road has an owner.
landing.body: Report a hazard, see where it is on the map, and know which agency is responsible for fixing it.

hazard.POTHOLE: A hole or broken patch in the road surface.
hazard.FALLEN_TREE: A tree or large branch blocking the road.
hazard.SINKHOLE: Ground collapsing under or beside the road.

landing.coverage: Covers federal, state, municipal and expressway roads in Peninsular Malaysia.
landing.choose: What do you want to do?

report.title: Seen a hazard on the road?
report.body: Send a photo and the location. It takes under a minute.

map.title: Browse the live map
map.body: See hazards reported near you. No account needed.

staff.title: JKR staff
staff.body: Sign in to see which roads to fix first.

report.photoTitle: Take a photo of the hazard
report.photoBody: One clear photo of the pothole, fallen tree or sinkhole.
report.privacyHint: Keep people and number plates out of the photo.
report.dragPin: Drag the pin onto the road where the hazard is.
report.aiSays: This looks like a {{hazard}}, severity {{severity}} of 5 ({{confidence}}% sure). Change it if that's wrong.
report.aiUncertain: The check isn't sure. Pick what you saw.
report.notHazard: This doesn't look like a road hazard. If it is, pick the type below.
report.aiDown: The photo check isn't available right now. Pick the type yourself; an officer will review the photo.

severity.2: Low: drivers can avoid it easily.
severity.4: High: could damage a vehicle or hurt a motorcyclist.
severity.5: Critical: a lane is unsafe or blocked.

report.notesHint: For example: left lane, near the junction. Don't include names.
report.sentBody: Your report has gone to the agency responsible for this road.
report.mergedBody: Someone reported this hazard already. Your report was added to it ({{count}} reports now).

errors.NOT_ON_ROAD: That spot is more than 50 m from a mapped road. Move the pin onto the road.
errors.OUTSIDE_COVERAGE: That spot is outside Peninsular Malaysia, which this service covers.
errors.PIN_TOO_FAR: The pin is {{distance_m}} m from where you took the photo. Keep it within {{max_m}} m.
errors.GPS_TOO_COARSE: Your location was only accurate to {{accuracy_m}} m. Move into the open and take the photo again.
errors.CAPTURE_EXPIRED: This photo has expired or was already checked. Take the photo again.

report.cameraOnlyHint: Photos can only be taken here, with your camera, so every report shows the hazard as it is now.

camera.deniedBody: Allow camera access for this site in your browser's settings, then try again. Reports need a photo taken now.
camera.unavailableBody: Reports need a photo taken with this device's camera. Open this page on a phone with a camera.
camera.insecureTitle: The camera needs a secure connection
camera.insecureBody: Open this page with https:// to use the camera.

gps.waiting: Finding your location. Keep location (GPS) on.
gps.coarse: Your location is only accurate to {{accuracy}} m. Move into the open; you can take the photo once it's within {{max}} m.
gps.denied: Location is blocked. Allow location for this site in your browser's settings; reports need it.
gps.unavailable: We can't find your location. Turn on location (GPS) and wait a moment.

report.locationFromGps: The pin is where you took the photo (accurate to {{accuracy}} m).
report.dragPinWithin: Drag the pin onto the road where the hazard is, within {{max}} m of where you took the photo.
report.pinClamped: The pin can't go more than {{max}} m from where you took the photo, so it stopped at the edge.
report.addressUnknown: Not found. You can type it on the next step.
report.addressHint: Filled in from the map. Correct it if it's wrong.
report.name: Your name
report.nameHint: Officers see it so they can follow up. It's never shown on the public map.
report.landmarkHint: For example: near the UTP main gate.

closed.REJECTED: An officer reviewed this report and closed it. It may not have been a road hazard.
closed.DUPLICATE: This was the same hazard as another report, so the two were combined.

analysis.searchPlaceholder: Road name or route number, e.g. FT1
analysis.noMatches: No roads match. Try the route number.
analysis.emptyBody: Search above, or select a road on the live map or in the ranking.
analysis.aiIntro: Get a plain-language summary of why this road matters. It uses only the figures on this page.
analysis.summaryTemplate: Summary (written from the figures, without AI)
analysis.potholesChart: Potholes reported each month for 12 months
analysis.adtEstimated: Estimated from the road type: no JKR census station on this road.
analysis.congestionChart: Average speed compared with free-flow speed, last 30 days
analysis.naturalChart: Fallen trees, sinkholes and warnings each month
analysis.floodNotYet: Flood warnings: not yet available for this road.
analysis.rain: Rain: {{d7}} mm in the last 7 days, {{d30}} mm in 30 days; {{next}} mm forecast this week.
analysis.noPredictions: No predictions for this road yet.
analysis.horizonNote: The 7-day outlook is on the live map's Prediction view.

zones.intro: Districts in the state you picked, with the most overdue repairs first.
zones.specialIntro: Ground that raises sinkhole risk. The outlines are approximate, drawn by hand rather than from JMG survey data.

assistant.intro: Ask about roads in your area. Answers come from this system's data and name the roads they rely on.
assistant.example1: Which 5 federal roads in Perak Tengah should we fix this month, and why?
assistant.example2: Are there weather warnings in Perak right now?
assistant.example3: What's the risk of sinkholes on Jalan Tronoh?
assistant.label: Your question
assistant.placeholder: Ask about roads, hazards or warnings

onboarding.s1Body: The scope at the top (State › District) filters every page. It's remembered next time.
onboarding.s2Body: The live map shows reported hazards. Switch to Prediction to see where they're likely next.
onboarding.s3Body: Prioritized roads ranks roads by a score you can see the parts of, with who to send each one to.

term.ADT: Average daily traffic: vehicles a day, from JKR's annual traffic census.
term.SLA: Service-level agreement: the repair deadline (federal roads: patched within 24 hours, repaired within 3 days).
term.PBT: Pihak Berkuasa Tempatan: the local council, such as Majlis Bandaraya Ipoh.

settings.accountBody: Your role and area are set by a JKR admin.
settings.languageBody: Saved to your account, so it follows you to other devices.
settings.passwordBody: Changing it signs you out on your other devices.
settings.passwordGoogle: You sign in with Google, so your password is managed by Google.
settings.googleBody: Sign in with Google instead of typing your password.
settings.googleOnlyWay: Google is the only way you sign in. Set a password first, then you can unlink it.
settings.deleteWhat1: Your email and sign-in are removed, and you're signed out everywhere.
settings.deleteWhat2: Hazards you reported stay on the map, because they're still on the road, but nothing links them to you.
settings.deleteWhat3: Your list of reports goes with the account.
settings.lastAdmin: You're the only admin, so this account can't be deleted. Make someone else an admin first.
settings.notConnected: Sign-in isn't connected in this copy of the app, so there's no account to manage.

myReports.emptyBody: Hazards you report appear here, with how far each repair has got.
